payloadRole: Top-level payload is chk-summary.log, the tool-check summary at the clean exact merge ad8486735 (one line per command with exit code, start and end). additionalPayloads are byte copies of the npm ci log, the done-test run output (stdout line, summary, manifest, evidence.jsonl, the server logs), the inspection and git-fact notes, and the tool-check logs. G-OWN: no tracked trace, log, screenshot or DB file; raw output stays outside Git.

additionalPayloads.name: npm-ci.log
additionalPayloads.note: real npm ci in the clean checkout (heavy-run build ticket); the trailing exit= line is appended by the ticket wrapper script

additionalPayloads.name: built-run-pre.txt
additionalPayloads.note: head, tree status, node version and start/end stamps around the done-test run

additionalPayloads.name: built-run-stdout.log
additionalPayloads.note: done-test stdout: the last line is the printed {verdict, headSha, buildId, required, passed, output}

additionalPayloads.name: inspect-run.txt
additionalPayloads.note: witness sequence, image hashes and file hashes computed from the run output

additionalPayloads.name: git-facts.txt
additionalPayloads.note: ancestry, tree equality and leaf blob identities at the clean exact merge

additionalPayloads.name: next-env-after-build.diff
additionalPayloads.note: git diff of the tracked, Next-generated next-env.d.ts after the production build (taken before the file was restored)
